packages.name: cli
notes: psc is a thin command router; argument parsing, config/input resolution, compilation pipeline, artifact writing, execution, and each user command are isolated modules.
Implemented commands: init, check, build, run, emit-lean, clean, help, version.
psconfig.json follows a TypeScript-familiar project/config model.
Current psc check/build claim ceiling is the initial reference-backed software subset; theorem/proof declarations are not yet submitted to pskernel.

packages.name: browser
notes: Browser foundation provides cancellation-aware streaming verification through an injected verifier adapter.
Kernel/module WebCrypto wiring remains outside this foundation until the browser-safe module codec is defined.

packages.name: syntax
notes: Pinned to ProofScript v0.7.0 with the v0.6.1 compiler-ready surface as the implementation baseline.
v0.6.1 parsing is split into type AST/parser, expression AST/parser, declaration parser, operator table, parser context, and Lean lowering modules.
Type syntax now has a first-class right-associative arrow AST instead of stringly-typed annotations.
Reference-backed software syntax covers const, def/function explicit parameters, D-CALL, primitive expressions/operators, grouping/unit, E-IF-BRACE, and lexical let.
Canonical Lean lowering is emitted from AST nodes; unsupported syntax fails closed.

packages.name: pretty
notes: Foundation provides compositional documents, width-aware groups/indentation, and diagnostic rendering.

packages.name: meta
notes: Foundation provides metavariable allocation/assignment, goals, transparency modes, and kernel-service protocols; unification/typeclass synthesis remain later milestones.

packages.name: elab
notes: Foundation provides checked elaboration/admission protocols and structured diagnostics; concrete ProofScript declaration elaboration remains later work.

packages.name: tactic
notes: Foundation provides generic exact, assumption, and intro state transitions; kernel proof-term construction remains adapter-driven and outside the TCB.

packages.name: compiler-ir
notes: Compiler IR is a distinct typed executable representation lowered from checked software HIR.
The initial IR preserves primitive runtime types, calls, unary/binary operations, conditionals, and lexical let.
Kernel Expr erasure/lowering, ADTs, closures, effects, and optimization passes remain later milestones.

packages.name: runtime
notes: Foundation implements exact bigint Nat/Int basics, saturating Nat subtraction, UInt8 normalization, and tagged constructor values; broader Lean runtime semantics remain later work.

packages.name: backend-ts
notes: Backend accepts only the typed executable compiler IR, not raw ProofScript or checked language HIR.
Backend emits TypeScript source; the TypeScript Compiler API type-checks it and emits JavaScript, .d.ts, and source maps.
Nat subtraction/division/modulo preserve current total semantics without duplicating operand evaluation.

packages.name: language
notes: Checked software HIR types and checking logic are split into separate modules.
Reference-backed checker covers Nat, Int, Bool, String, Unit, declarations, calls, operators, braced if, and lexical let with shadowing/type checks.
This checker remains outside the TCB; theorem/proof acceptance still requires elaboration to pskernel.

packages.name: lsp
notes: Foundation provides UTF-16 offset/position mapping and diagnostic conversion; protocol transport and semantic requests remain later milestones.

packages.name: project
notes: Foundation provides deterministic dependency ordering, cycle/missing-dependency rejection, and an in-memory build cache; npm/config integration remains later work.
Lean 4.34 final removed deprecated in-kernel native reduction; no NativeEvaluator/native-ir kernel extension is part of the compatibility architecture.
